title: Annual Bike Counts (Super Tuesday)
processing: Select every site in the maximum survey year present in this export. Metadata modification dates are not survey dates.
Copy published site_id, latitude, longitude and description without geocoding or coordinate rounding.
Rename published total to count_7_9am; verify it equals the sum of all eight morning 15-minute intervals.
Do not sum leg totals: those combine entries and exits and could double count movements.
Do not calculate daily averages, evening peaks or growth. Counts are survey observations, not unique people across all sites.
Use a linear zero-based Vega-Lite size scale: circle size represents pixel area.
scope: Historical morning survey snapshot. Latest year in this particular public export, not a claim that 2017 is the latest survey ever conducted.

boundary.processing: Coordinates retained; ring winding normalised for D3/Vega spherical rendering. Contemporary boundary provides location context, not a historical 2017 boundary claim.
